credits.title: New Eden
credits.overview: Damião, a young black priest, settles in a village of European immigrants, tobacco farmers in southern Brazil. Received with disdain, Damião discovers that sinister forces have taken root in the town.

credits.title: I Am Going to Miss You
credits.overview: Amanda and Caio are a trans couple who share seven years of love and dreams. However, when they decide to live together, the differences between them begin to take their toll.

credits.title: Caviar Star
credits.overview: A young Brazilian actress preparing for a once in a lifetime audition in Los Angeles is haunted by the spirit of another actress, and triggers a battle between obsession and possession as she becomes more immersed in the role.

credits.title: All That Matters
credits.overview: A short film that tells the story of three families of trans people and the processes of acceptance and celebration of their identities. These mothers, fathers, and grandparents take a step forward and decide to fight for a society that respects and values diversity.

credits.title: Lunch Break
credits.overview: 1979. Four female workers have lunch break inside the ladies' room, at a metallurgical factory. Between laughs and scuffles, each one has a secret of their own.
